This plot explores the relationship between vehicle weight and fuel efficiency
in R's built-in `mtcars` data.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: vehicle-plot

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Heavier Cars Tend to Use More Fuel",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Fuel efficiency (miles per gallon)",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This line was written on a second machine.
